entries.note: The firm takes the parcel in. The page writes 收件员, the collector, after it, with their name when it gives one; the adapter takes both out.

entries.wording: 快件从【北京分拨中心】正在装车，准备飞往【广州分拨中心】
entries.note: Loaded at one sorting centre to be flown to the next. Any centres.

entries.wording: 快件已到达【广州分拨中心】准备发往【珠海市保税区】
entries.note: At a sorting centre, to be sent on. Any centres.

entries.wording: 快件已到达【保税区】，准备派件
entries.note: At the centre that delivers it, before the round starts. Any centre.
